title: A polynomial ring in finitely many variables is smooth over its coefficient ring
statement: Let $C$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, and $C[y_1,\dots,y_n]$ the polynomial ring in $n$ variables. Then the ring map $C\to C[y_1,\dots,y_n]$ is smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Definition Tag 00T6 (definition-standard-smooth) with c = 0 and Lemma Tag 00T7 (lemma-standard-smooth) (1): C[y_1,...,y_n] is standard smooth over C, hence smooth; also Lemma Tag 00TK (lemma-polynomial-ring-formally-smooth)
